verdict.summary: Round 3 resolves both round-2 major findings. Soft-branch lowering now tracks scope per traversal path rather than with a global emitted set, so each independently binding OPTIONAL or NOT EXISTS branch restates a shared target's class and attribute constraints; the converging-target tests exercise both OPTIONAL/OPTIONAL and OPTIONAL/NOT EXISTS cases. The handoff restore gate now suppresses hydration only before the first workspace has loaded, and its tests cover a live handoff followed by a workspace switch. The implementation and tests are consistent with the documented SPARQL scope semantics, and no new correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue is evident in the diff.
